title: Delivery Reporting Period
description: A half-open delivery reporting period: `start` is inclusive and `end` is exclusive. Both are instants on the reporting time zone's period boundaries.

start.description: Inclusive RFC 3339 start instant. For a date-bounded request, the start of start_date in the reporting timezone, written with that zone's UTC offset or as the equivalent UTC instant (e.g., 2026-04-15T00:00:00-04:00 or 2026-04-15T04:00:00Z for America/New_York; 2026-04-15T00:00:00Z for UTC).

end.description: Exclusive RFC 3339 end instant. For a date-bounded request, the start of end_date in the reporting timezone (e.g., 2026-04-16T00:00:00-04:00 for a report covering 2026-04-15 in America/New_York).

timezone.description: Reporting timezone applied to this report, as 'UTC' or an IANA timezone identifier. It equals the in-scope products' reporting_capabilities.timezone. start_date, end_date, the reporting_period boundaries, daily_breakdown[].date, and daily, weekly, or monthly windows[] all use it, so a stored report stays interpretable if the product's capability later changes. Sellers SHOULD return it on reads without reporting_revision_id whenever every in-scope media buy shares one reporting timezone. Exact reporting_revision_id reads return the revision period, which carries source_timezone instead.
